1. [LOCAL] Retrieve current pet vaccination records. | out pet_vaccinations
2. [PROCESS] Filter out pets due for a booster within the next 14 days. | out upcoming_boosters
3. [LOCAL] Translate the reminder message into Spanish. | out spanish_reminder
4. [LOCAL] Loop through each pet in $step2.upcoming_boosters to prepare text messages. | out text_messages
5. [LOCAL] Send text messages to pet owners. | out sms_responses | api SMS Messaging Service / Send Text Messages | args {"recipients": "$step5.text_messages.recipients", "message": "$step5.text_messages.message"}
6. [LOCAL] Identify pet owners who responded affirmatively to the text message. | out confirmed_appointments
7. [LOCAL] Book appointments for the identified pets. | out appointment_bookings
8. [LOCAL] Prepare a list of pets needing booster vaccinations for the week. | out weekly_booster_list
9. [LOCAL] Translate the booster list into English. | out english_booster_list
10. [WRITE] Send the booster list to the veterinarians via email. | out email_status | api Mailrecipe / Send Email | args {"to": "$veterinarian.email", "subject": "Weekly Booster List", "body": "$step10.english_booster_list"}

1. [READ] Retrieve lab report photo from patient. | out report_photo
2. [PROCESS] Use OCR to read text from $step1.report_photo. | out extracted_text
3. [PROCESS] Parse extracted text to identify and extract test values. | out test_values
4. [PROCESS] Compare test values against normal ranges. | out out_of_range_tests
5. [PROCESS] Summarize flagged results for the doctor. | out summary_report
6. [PROCESS] Book a follow-up appointment based on flagged results. | out appointment_details
7. [WRITE] Email summary report to patient in their preferred language. | out email_status | api MailRecipe / Send Email | args {"to": "$patient.email", "subject": "Lab Report Summary", "body": "$summary_report", "language": "$patient.preferred_language"}

1. [LOCAL] Collect daily updates from the team members. | out daily_updates
2. [PROCESS] Parse daily updates to categorize them as 'done', 'doing' or 'blocked'. | out categorized_updates
3. [PROCESS] Analyze the mood of each update to determine sentiment. | out mood_analysis
4. [PROCESS] Generate a short summary of the categorized and mood-analyzed updates. | out summary
5. [LOCAL] Post the summary to the team chat. | out chat_post
6. [PROCESS] Identify any blockers from the categorized updates. | out blockers
7. [PROCESS] Open tasks for each identified blocker. | out task_opened | api Task Management / Create Task | args {"title": "$step6.blockers.title", "description": "$step6.blockers.description", "priority": "high"}
8. [LOCAL] Gather all updates for the week. | out weekly_updates
9. [PROCESS] Summarize the weekly updates. | out weekly_summary
10. [LOCAL] Prepare a weekly digest email. | out weekly_digest_email
11. [WRITE] Send the weekly digest email to the designated recipient. | out email_sent | api Mailrecipe / Send Email | args {"to": "$user.email", "subject": "Weekly Standup Digest", "body": "$step10.weekly_digest_email.body"}

1. [LOCAL] Look up comparable titles for your debut novel. | out comparable_titles
2. [PROCESS] Write a launch blurb for your debut novel. | out launch_blurb
3. [PROCESS] Check the grammar of the launch blurb. | out checked_blurb
4. [LOCAL] Generate a promo image for your debut novel. | out promo_image
5. [LOCAL] Create a short link to the preorder page. | out preorder_link
6. [LOCAL] Post the launch on social media platforms. | out social_media_post_status
7. [LOCAL] Collect email addresses from your mailing list. | out mailing_list_emails
8. [PROCESS] Compose an email to your mailing list with the preorder link and launch details. | out mailing_list_email_content
9. [WRITE] Send the email to your mailing list. | out mailing_list_email_status | api Mailrecipe / Send Email | args {"to": "$step7.mailing_list_emails", "subject": "Preorder Launch for Your Debut Novel", "body": "$step8.mailing_list_email_content"}

1. [LOCAL] Identify the patient's language preference. | out language_preference
2. [LOCAL] Search for available interpreters matching the patient's language preference. | out interpreter_list
3. [LOCAL] Select the first available interpreter from the list. | out selected_interpreter
4. [LOCAL] Reserve an interpreter room for the scheduled appointment. | out reservation_status
5. [LOCAL] Translate the visit instructions into the patient's preferred language. | out translated_instructions
6. [LOCAL] Add the appointment details to the selected interpreter's calendar. | out calendar_update_status
7. [LOCAL] Prepare a text message with the appointment time in the patient's language. | out appointment_time_message
8. [LOCAL] Send the appointment time message to the patient. | out message_sent_status
9. [LOCAL] Calculate the cost of the interpreter service based on the duration of the appointment. | out cost_per_hour
10. [LOCAL] Generate an invoice for the department. | out invoice_generated

1. [LOCAL] Check cloud forecast for three northern lights viewing spots in Tromsø. | out cloud_forecast
2. [LOCAL] Look up sunset times for each of the three viewing spots. | out sunset_times
3. [LOCAL] Calculate the driving distance from Tromsø town center to each viewing spot. | out distances
4. [LOCAL] Determine the best viewing spot based on the cloud forecast and sunset times. | out best_spot
5. [LOCAL] Text guests with the pickup time for the chosen best spot. | out guest_text_message
6. [LOCAL] Add the tour to your personal calendar. | out calendar_entry

1. [LOCAL] Generate a fair chore rota for the upcoming week. | out rota_schedule
2. [LOCAL] Add the chore rota to the family calendar. | out calendar_entry
3. [LOCAL] Create a daily reminder for each child to do their chores. | out daily_reminder
4. [LOCAL] Assign a badge image to each child based on completing all chores. | out badge_image
5. [LOCAL] Compile a weekly summary of completed chores. | out summary_report
6. [WRITE] Send the weekly summary report to the partner's email. | out email_status | api MailRecipe / Send Email | args {"to": "$partner_email", "subject": "Weekly Chore Summary", "body": "$step5.summary_report"}

1. [LOCAL] Check June forecast for both fields each evening. | out forecast_check
2. [LOCAL] Look up sunrise and sunset times for both fields. | out times_info
3. [PROCESS] Determine a cutting window based on the forecast and times. | out cutting_window
4. [LOCAL] Text contractor to confirm cutting window. | out contractor_text
5. [LOCAL] Add cutting window to personal calendar. | out calendar_entry
6. [LOCAL] Prepare weekly email with forecast details. | out email_content
7. [WRITE] Send weekly email to wife with forecast details. | out email_send | api MailRecipe / Send Email | args {"to": "$user.wife_email", "subject": "Weekly Hay Forecast Update", "body": "$step6.email_content"}

1. [LOCAL] Validate the couple's email for booking. | out validated_email | api Email Validation / Validate Email
2. [LOCAL] Book a tour room slot based on availability. | out booked_slot | api Event Booking / Reserve Slot
3. [LOCAL] Add the booking to your personal calendar. | out added_to_calendar
4. [LOCAL] Text the couple with directions to the venue. | out sent_directions | api SMS Messaging / Send Text Message
5. [LOCAL] Add the couple to the CRM database. | out added_to_crm | api Customer Relationship Management / Add Contact
6. [LOCAL] Generate and email a brochure to the couple. | out sent_brochure | api Marketing Materials / Create and Send Brochure

1. [LOCAL] Validate the new member's email address. | out validated_email
2. [LOCAL] Create a new account for the validated member. | out created_account
3. [LOCAL] Invoice the monthly fee for the new member. | out invoiced_fee
4. [LOCAL] Add the tool induction event to the calendar. | out added_event
5. [LOCAL] Post a welcome message in the members' team chat. | out posted_message
6. [LOCAL] Retrieve the house rules document. | out house_rules_document
7. [LOCAL] Email the new member with the house rules document attached. | out sent_email | api Email Service / Send Email | args {"to": "$user.email", "subject": "Welcome to Our Hackerspace!", "body": "Please find enclosed the House Rules.", "attachments": ["$step6.house_rules_document"]}

1. [LOCAL] Fetch wind forecast for the archery club's shooting field. | out wind_forecast
2. [PROCESS] Determine if the wind conditions are suitable for outdoor shooting based on the forecast. | out shooting_recommendation
3. [LOCAL] Post the recommendation in the team chat. | out chat_post
4. [LOCAL] Text each member of the archery club about the recommendation. | out text_message
5. [LOCAL] Calendar the archery club's outdoor shoot event. | out event_calendar
6. [LOCAL] Invoice the range fees monthly. | out invoice_creation

1. [LOCAL] Validate the parent's email address for each nursery place enquiry. | out validated_email | api Email Validation Service / Validate Email Address
2. [LOCAL] Create a visit slot on the calendar for each validated email. | out visit_slot | api Calendar Management / Schedule Appointment
3. [LOCAL] Generate a confirmation text with the visit time for each email. | out confirmation_text | api SMS Messaging / Send Text Message
4. [LOCAL] Prepare and send an information pack email to each parent. | out info_pack_email | api Email Marketing / Send Email Campaign
5. [LOCAL] Open a task to follow up after the visit for each email. | out follow_up_task | api Task Management / Create Task

1. [LOCAL] Retrieve patron requests for the current month. | out patron_requests
2. [LOCAL] Search for review coverage of each book in the patron requests. | out review_coverage
3. [PROCESS] Score the tone of each review using sentiment analysis. | out tone_scores
4. [LOCAL] Identify the top 3 books based on the highest scores. | out best_titles
5. [LOCAL] Check the budget and make an invoice entry for the selected books. | out invoice_entry
6. [LOCAL] Prepare a list of the best titles to be ordered. | out order_list
7. [LOCAL] Create a new arrivals post for social media. | out social_post
8. [WRITE] Send the invoice entry to the finance department. | out finance_status | api Invoice Management / Create Invoice | args {"books": "$best_titles", "amount": "$invoice_entry.amount"}

1. [LOCAL] Validate each parent's email format. | out validated_emails
2. [LOCAL] Invoice the fee for the summer school based on validated emails. | out invoice_details
3. [LOCAL] Add rehearsals to the calendar for each child. | out rehearsal_calendar
4. [LOCAL] Prepare the script for distribution. | out script_document
5. [LOCAL] Send an email to all parents with the script attached. | out email_script_sent
6. [LOCAL] Text a reminder about the show to all parents. | out reminder_text_sent
7. [LOCAL] Post the show details on social media platforms. | out social_media_posted

1. [LOCAL] Check if the website is online. | out site_online_status
2. [LOCAL] Measure the load speed of the website. | out load_speed
3. [LOCAL] Verify the SSL certificate is valid. | out ssl_status
4. [LOCAL] Search for news mentioning the brand. | out brand_news
5. [PROCESS] Combine all the collected information into a PDF report. | out report_content | api Report Builder / Generate Report | args {"siteOnline": "$site_online_status", "loadSpeed": "$load_speed", "sslStatus": "$ssl_status", "brandNews": "$brand_news"}
6. [LOCAL] Prepare the email template with recipient details. | out email_template
7. [LOCAL] Iterate over each client and send the email with the PDF report attached. | out email_status | api MailRecipe / Send Email | args {"clients": "$client_list", "emailTemplate": "$email_template", "reportContent": "$report_content", "sendDate": "5th"}

1. [LOCAL] Create a checklist item for checking the new site is online. | out online_check
2. [LOCAL] Add a checklist item for verifying the SSL certificate is valid. | out ssl_check
3. [LOCAL] Generate a short link for the new site. | out short_link
4. [LOCAL] Prepare a launch report template. | out report_template
5. [LOCAL] Draft an email to the client with the launch report. | out email_content
6. [LOCAL] Post the launch announcement on social media platforms. | out social_post
7. [LOCAL] Set up an invoice for the final payment. | out invoice_setup
8. [LOCAL] Compile the entire launch checklist including all items. | out full_launch_checklist

1. [LOCAL] Calendar each booking for fairs and parties. | out booking_calendar
2. [LOCAL] Invoice a deposit for each booking. | out deposit_invoice
3. [LOCAL] Text the host with the arrival information. | out text_host
4. [PROCESS] Generate a design sheet image for the theme. | out design_sheet_image | api Design Sheet Generator / Create Design Sheet
5. [LOCAL] Post the design sheet image on social media platforms. | out social_post
6. [LOCAL] Track paint inventory levels. | out paint_inventory
7. [LOCAL] Order paints when the inventory level is low. | out paint_order | api Paint Ordering System / Place Order | args {"paints": "$paint_inventory.low_paints"}

1. [LOCAL] Collect recent news articles related to the brand. | out news_articles
2. [LOCAL] Analyze sentiment for each article in $news_articles. | out sentiment_scores
3. [LOCAL] Summarize the coverage of the brand based on the analyzed articles. | out coverage_summary
4. [PROCESS] Generate a PDF document from the collected information. | out pdf_document | api Report Generation / Create PDF | args {input: "$coverage_summary"}
5. [LOCAL] Prepare a headline for the report. | out headline
6. [LOCAL] Post the headline in the team chat. | out chat_post_status
7. [LOCAL] Compose the email body with the report details. | out email_body
8. [WRITE] Send the report via email to the client. | out email_status | api MailRecipe / Send Email | args {to: "$client.email", subject: "Weekly Brand Reputation Report", body: "$email_body"}

1. [LOCAL] Define the theme word for the game jam. | out theme_word
2. [PROCESS] Generate concept art based on the defined theme word. | out concept_art
3. [PROCESS] Voice the dialogue using speech synthesis technology. | out synthesized_dialogue
4. [PROCESS] Translate the synthesized dialogue into Spanish. | out spanish_translation
5. [PROCESS] Create tasks for each feature of the game. | out tasks_list
6. [PROCESS] Compile all created elements into a game build. | out build_package
7. [API] Upload the game build package to the game jam platform. | api Game Jam Platform / Upload Build | args {"buildPackage": "$step6.build_package"}

1. [LOCAL] Retrieve the recipe details for sourdough bread. | out recipe_details
2. [PROCESS] Calculate the nutritional information for each loaf using the recipe details. | out nutritional_info
3. [LOCAL] Generate a QR code for the order page. | out qr_code
4. [LOCAL] Compile the bake menu items for posting on social media. | out bake_menu
5. [LOCAL] Prepare a text message for collection reminders. | out collection_reminder
6. [LOCAL] Gather cafe supply details for invoicing. | out cafe_supply_details
7. [PROCESS] Invoice the cafes based on the supply details. | out invoice_details | api Cafe Invoicing / Generate Invoice | args {"details": "$step6.cafe_supply_details"}
8. [LOCAL] Post the bake menu on social media platforms. | out social_media_post_status
9. [LOCAL] Send the collection reminder text messages to customers. | out text_message_status

1. [READ] Retrieve the weather forecast for the upcoming quarter. | out forecast_data | api Weather Forecast / Get Forecast
2. [READ] Obtain sunrise and sunset times for the upcoming quarter. | out sunrise_sunset_data | api Sunrise Sunset / Get Times
3. [PROCESS] Calculate sunshine hours based on the weather forecast and sunrise/sunset times. | out sunshine_hours | api Sunshine Calculation / Compute Sunshine
4. [LOCAL] Summarize the quarter's performance including weather conditions, sunshine hours, and any relevant statistics. | out quarter_summary
5. [PROCESS] Generate a PDF report combining the summary, forecast, and sunrise/sunset data. | out pdf_report | api Report Generation / Create PDF
6. [WRITE] Send the PDF report to all members via email. | out email_status | api Mailrecipe / Send Email | args {"to": "$user.members", "subject": "Quarterly Solar Co-op Performance Report", "body": "$pdf_report"}
7. [LOCAL] Post an update on social media platforms. | out social_update | api Social Media / Post Update

1. [LOCAL] Read and clean up the grammar in your listings. | out cleaned_listings
2. [LOCAL] Pull keywords for tags from the cleaned listings. | out keywords
3. [LOCAL] Convert prices in the listings to both euros and dollars. | out converted_prices
4. [READ] Retrieve old labels from photos of the pieces. | out old_labels
5. [PROCESS] Date each piece using the retrieved old labels. | out dated_pieces
6. [READ] Fetch new arrival information. | out new_arrivals
7. [LOCAL] Post the new arrivals on social media platforms. | out social_media_post | api Social Media Marketing / Post New Arrivals | args {"platforms": ["Instagram", "Facebook"], "content": "$step6.new_arrivals"}

1. [READ] Scan and process the specification document. | out document_content
2. [PROCESS] Extract key sections and requirements from $step1.document_content. | out summary_requirements
3. [PROCESS] Identify and extract keywords related to the scoring criteria from $step1.document_content. | out scoring_keywords
4. [PROCESS] For each section identified in $step2.summary_requirements, create a task outline. | out tasks | api Task Creation / Generate Tasks | args {"sections": $step2.summary_requirements}

1. [LOCAL] Book the hall room for the charity Christmas grotto event. | out booking_details
2. [LOCAL] Generate a festive poster design for the charity Christmas grotto event. | out poster_design
3. [LOCAL] Post the festive poster design on social media platforms. | out social_media_posted
4. [LOCAL] Create a QR code for visitors to sign up for the charity Christmas grotto event. | out qr_code_generated
5. [READ] Get the weather forecast for the location of the charity Christmas grotto event. | out weather_forecast | api Weather Forecast / Get Weather Forecast | args {"location": "charityChristmasGrottoLocation"}
